title: OAuth Authentication Not Supported for Highest Plan Tier
body:
**Bug Description**
I have subscribed to highest plan.  But I am getting this error related to auth. API Error: 401 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"authentication_error","message":"OAuth authentication is currently not supported."}}

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.83
- Feedback ID: aac548da-e00b-4de2-807f-55f56d3910a1

top_comments.author: swoopsus
top_comments.body:
I can add this: It is NOT environmental, and not account specific. I have tried multiple devices, uninstalled, reinstalled, two different pro accounts. I get it constantly. My theory is its a an undisclosed rate limit. 

I got it multiple times yesterday. The logout and login worked twice, on both accounts. Then first one, then the other stopped working with the 401, and are now both getting the error consistently. I was doing a heavy workload yesterday. This is deliberate.

top_comments.author: swoopsus
top_comments.body:
SOLUTION! The solution is to downgrade to 1.0.81. Fixed immediately and permanently. I verified by going back to 1.0.82/3, and the problem returned.

Took me half a day to find the solution. Sharing so others dont have to.

Sometimes logging out and in will work, but in my two pro plans eventually that didn't either. 

Downgrade works like a charm.
